hero.title: You play. We count the chips.
hero.description: Buy-ins, rebuys, blinds and pots: {appName} keeps the bank on the living-room TV, and everyone bets from their phone.
hero.photoAlt: Friends around a poker table, the game showing on the TV

howItWorks.title: Three minutes from the couch to the first deal.

setup.title: Set up your table
setup.description: Name the seats, set the buy-in and the blinds. Your settings are remembered for next time.

scan.title: Your friends scan in
scan.description: A QR code on the TV, a seat to pick, and everyone gets their buy-in. No account needed to play.
scan.shotAlt: Picking a seat on a phone

play.title: Just play
play.description: Bets are recorded, the pot adds itself up, the blinds go up on time. At the end of the night, the tally is ready.

tv.title: The whole table, on the big screen.
tv.description: Cast the game to the living-room screen: the pot, the stacks and the next blind level are readable from the couch.
tv.roomAlt: A living room with the table showing on the wall-mounted TV
tv.screenAlt: The full-screen TV view of a table

blinds.title: Timed blinds
blinds.description: The next level shows up with its countdown.

pot.title: The pot, live
pot.description: Every bet lands on the table the moment it is made.

qr.title: The QR code, always on screen
qr.description: Latecomers join the table without stopping the hand.

phone.title: Your stack, in your pocket.
phone.description: Every player sees their balance and bets with a tap. No more chips sliding around, no more “wait, how much did you put in?”.
phone.handAlt: A hand holding a phone above a pile of chips
phone.screenAlt: A player's stack and actions on their phone

actions.title: Call, raise, fold
actions.description: The game's actions, and only those.

turn.title: It buzzes when it's your turn
turn.description: Put your phone down and talk to the others.

tally.title: The tally at the end
tally.description: Who owes what to whom, worked out before anyone leaves.

gallery.title: Everyone at the table, no one stuck at the bank.
gallery.description: The host gets to play too. {appName} takes care of the rest.

photos.chips: A close-up of a stack of chips
photos.host: The host in front of the TV
photos.table: The table from above, phones lying on the felt

cta.title: Your next game night starts here.
cta.description: Your first table is free. Your friends only need their phone.

guest.name: Guest
guest.title: Join the table
guest.description: Sign up to host your games and invite your friends.
